tools.name: cezannehr_list_people
tools.description: List people in Cezanne HR, including leavers and new hires unless active_only is true. Returns one page; use next_skip to read more. OData: People.

tools.name: cezannehr_get_person
tools.description: Get one person by Person Code, optionally with selected fields. OData: People('<code>').

tools.name: cezannehr_get_current_employment
tools.description: Get the current primary employment of one person by Person Code. OData: People('<code>')/PeopleToEmploymentCurrentPrimary.

tools.name: cezannehr_list_org_units
tools.description: List organisational units (departments, teams, locations as set up in Cezanne HR). OData: OrgUnits.

tools.name: cezannehr_list_absence_events
tools.description: List absence events (leave and sickness) for people. Filter by date or person in $filter. OData: PersonAbsenceEvents.

tools.name: cezannehr_list_timesheets
tools.description: List person timesheets (time recorded per person and period). OData: PersonTimesheets.

tools.name: cezannehr_read_table
tools.description: Read one page of any allowed Cezanne HR OData table (for example Employments, Jobs, PersonTimesheetDetails, OrgUnitPositionDeployments). Sensitive tables are not offered. Read-only.
